# ETLAQ KSA (شركة إطلاق المتميزة المحدودة)

ETLAQ KSA is the premier provider of professional engineering solutions in Saudi Arabia, specializing in soil cement grouting, cavity/void detection, and geophysical surveys.

## Core Services

- [Soil Grouting (حقن التربة)](https://etlaqksa.com/services/grouting) - Specialized cement grouting, foundation underpinning, and differential settlement remediation.
- [Cavity Detection (كشف التكهفات)](https://etlaqksa.com/services/cavity) - Drilling-based cavity probing, mapping, and geogrid stabilization.
- [Geophysical Surveys (الدراسات الجيوفيزيائية)](https://etlaqksa.com/services/geophysical) - Subsurface imaging via Electrical Resistivity Tomography (ERT) and Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR).
